entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The fascist governing body of Ghirapur on Kaladesh until the Indigo Revolution, replaced by the Avishkar Assembly.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: The democratic ruling body that replaced the Consulate.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: A faction opposing the Consulate by refusing safety regulations and aether quotas.

entities.name: New Culture Collective
entities.description: A group fomenting revolutionary fervor, later a countercultural political bloc.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A former Renegade named consul of Allocation who defended the Aetherflux Reservoir.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Head judge of the Inventors' Fair, later declared Special Grand Consul, finally defeated.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Senior Inspector for the Inventors' Fair who launched a diversionary attack against the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Captain Baral
entities.description: Chief of Compliance who launched a diversionary attack.

entities.name: Dhiren Baral
entities.description: A prisoner released to assist in the defense against the Phyrexians and later forgiven.

entities.name: Kambal
entities.description: Consul of Allocation, replaced by Pia Nalaar.

entities.name: Padeem
entities.description: Consul of Innovation who held her position following the revolt.

entities.name: Avaati Vya
entities.description: The inventor who developed a process to refine volatile raw aether.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whose early warnings gave Kaladesh time to prepare.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A figure whose early warnings gave Kaladesh time to prepare.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader interested in Kaladesh's aether, leading the Chrome Host.

entities.name: Ranaj
entities.description: Chief of the Consulate Enforcers.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalkers distracted by the Consulate's diversion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Kaladesh in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane renamed Avishkar after the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city founded by the eleven artificers.

entities.name: Aether Hub
entities.description: The facility attacked by the renegades and retaken by the Consulate.

entities.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
entities.description: The reservoir the Phyrexians raced to twist, whose breach would destroy the city.

entities.name: War of Eleven
entities.description: A war between the eleven most powerful nobles for a stretch of coastal territory.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The renegade uprising against the Consulate.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Kaladesh resisted by Project Golden Scale.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: The mostly peaceful insurgence that removed the Consulate from power.

events.summary: The War of Eleven ends when the nobles' court inventors open communication and end the conflict, founding Ghirapur and the first Consulate.
events.quote: The eleven artificers made the contested land their nation

events.summary: After Avaati Vya refines raw aether, the Consulate distributes it, leading to an inventors' renaissance.
events.quote: Their efforts led to a plane-wide inventors' renaissance

events.summary: The Consulate bans fire magic, making pyromancy punishable by death.
events.quote: The Consulate banned fire magic and made pyromancy punishable with a death sentence

events.summary: After unknown magic users save Renegade Prime from execution, the Consulate takes all unapproved inventions into custody.
events.quote: the Consulate issued an ordinance to all citizens of Ghirapur

events.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Hub and begin a revolt; the Consulate diverts the Gatewatch with Baral and Dovin Baan and retakes the hub.
events.quote: the Consulate retook control of the Aether Hub

events.summary: After Tezzeret's final defeat, the Consulate yields to the Renegades and Pia Nalaar is named consul of Allocation.
events.quote: Pia Nalaar was named as the new consul of Allocation.

events.summary: Warned by Chandra and Saheeli, Kaladesh resists the Phyrexians with Project Golden Scale, and Dhiren Baral is released to help.
events.quote: Dhiren Baral was released from prison to assist with the defense.

events.summary: The Phyrexians race to the Aetherflux Reservoir while Pia and the artisans defend it, turning a quick fight into a protracted struggle.
events.quote: Pia and its artisans worked to defend the reservoir

events.summary: The new Consulate forgives all of Baral's previous transgressions.
events.quote: the new Consulate forgave all of Baral's previous transgressions

events.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate; the Avishkar Assembly is installed and renames the plane Avishkar.
events.quote: the Consulate was removed from power in the Indigo Revolution

relations.quote: Kambal , Consul of Allocation. Replaced by Pia Nalaar.
The Renegades directly opposed the Consulate

relations.note: replaced it after the Indigo Revolution
relations.quote: a new, democratic ruling body, called the Avishkar Assembly , was installed
